name: DappleOS
description:
DappleOS is a cosmetic medicine practice management platform that streamlines clinical, operational and commercial workflows to unlock measurable, scalable growth. It analytics connection lets you ask questions about your clinic's data in plain language — and get real answers, with no SQL or screen-clicking.

Ask things like:
  - "What was revenue last month, by location?"
  - "Which treatments are growing fastest this quarter?"
  - "Run the Revenue widget from my Sales dashboard."
  - "Break down bookings by staff member."

Analytics & reporting
  - Browse your data — See what's available to ask about across your clinic.
  - Run your dashboards — Pull live numbers straight from your saved charts and widgets on demand.
  - Ask anything custom — Run ad-hoc reports when no existing dashboard covers the question.
  - Slice and compare — Break any figure down by location, staff, or service to see what's driving it.
  - Scope by location — Focus any answer on a single clinic or across all of them.

  Explore your setup
  - Products & prices — Look up retail items with pricing, costs, and barcodes.
  - Stock — Check stock levels and availability across the catalog.
  - Treatments & services — Browse your service menu and find any bookable service with its price.
  - Staff — See team members with their roles and permissions.
  - Tags — Review the categories that organise your products and treatments.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DappleOS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DappleOS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api-au.dapplecrm.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DappleOS MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DappleOS lists 13 MCP tools, including analytics_dashboard, analytics_dashboard_widget, analytics_dashboards, analytics_execute_query, analytics_expand_query, analytics_locations, analytics_tables, product_detail, products_search, tags_list, treatment_options, and treatments_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DappleOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DappleOS in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
DappleOS requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DappleOS is developed by DappleOS. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
